responsibility: Implements the executable logic of the Xstormy16 GCC backend behind the target macros and RTL patterns. This file owns target hooks for costs, calling convention details, argument and return handling, address legitimacy, reload preferences, section and assembler emission, builtins, trampolines, stack-frame/prologue/epilogue generation, and machine-dependent reorganization; it also supplies the RTL expansion/output helpers referenced from stormy16.md, including conditional-branch expansion, move/arithmetic splitting, switch table emission, and peephole-style branch/memory rewrites specific to the Stormy16 instruction set.
same_name_distinction: Implements the procedural C++ side of the Stormy16 port: target hooks, expanders, assembler-output helpers, and machine-dependent reorganization routines that are referenced by the macros in stormy16.h and by named RTL patterns in stormy16.md. Unlike stormy16.h, it does not define the static machine description macros; unlike stormy16.md, it is executable helper code rather than declarative instruction patterns; unlike stormy16.opt, it does not declare command-line options.
